facts.business: RPP Infra Projects Limited is an Engineering, Procurement and Construction (EPC) company executing infrastructure projects such as roads, highways, expressways, irrigation, and buildings for government agencies.
key_risks: Geopolitical tensions leading to higher project execution costs, supply chain disruptions, and scheduling challenges
Intense competition and relatively weak order inflows for road-centric contractors
Dependence on imported equipment or energy-intensive materials
Arbitration proceedings for receivables from NTECL amounting to Rs.17.84 Crores
